surfaces.label: AMICA mosaic
surfaces.coverage: Seven Hayabusa AMICA v-band photographs from September and October 2005, including closer views from north of the equator. Registered through the archived Gaskell Cartesian backplanes. Brightness is approximately normalized and matched across overlaps; photographed shadows remain. The grid marks unsupported surface coverage.

quality.originalArrayOrientation: vertical reversal verified pixel for pixel
quality.calibration: Archived SUM minus near-zero-exposure DIFF removes bias/dark/smear onboard; divide by the original preflight v flat and exposure. Relative detector brightness, not absolute radiance or albedo.
quality.limitations: Lossy 8-bit image; no pixel-quality plane, stray-light restoration, temporal flat correction or absolute calibration.

photometry.formula: D=2*cos(i)/(cos(i)+cos(e)); linear radiance divided by D before interpolation; reference D(0,0)=1.
photometry.applicationLighting: Uniform flood displays normalized imagery; Shadows applies the existing fixed-epoch Sun bank.
photometry.limitations: No phase correction, Hapke roughness correction or cast-shadow recovery. Relative display brightness, not measured albedo.

display.units: relative flat-fielded detector brightness with approximate disk normalization; linear grayscale display

frames.previewPolicy: Radial preview with ambiguous intersections withheld; retained triangle atlas uses closest original source point in 3D.

surfaces.label: Elevation
surfaces.coverage: Released global model; detailed geometry is simplified for the display.

surfaceSampling.previewPolicy: Radial rays with more than one distinct source intersection are withheld; the triangle atlas samples the source surface in 3D.

transfer.method: Closest full-source triangle point in 3D; source barycentric radius and normal. No radial branch selection.
